AddSharesToExpressSync.title: AddSharesToExpressSync

CreateGateway.title: CreateGateway
CreateGateway.summary: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go gateway.

CreateGatewayBlockVolume.title: CreateGatewayBlockVolume
CreateGatewayBlockVolume.summary: Creates a block volume (iSCSI) for an iSCSI gateway.

CreateGatewayCacheDisk.title: CreateGatewayCacheDisk
CreateGatewayCacheDisk.summary: Creates a cache disk for a gateway.

CreateGatewayFileShare.title: CreateGatewayFileShare
CreateGatewayFileShare.summary: Creates a file share for a file gateway.

CreateGatewayLogging.title: CreateGatewayLogging
CreateGatewayLogging.summary: Enables log monitoring for a gateway.

CreateGatewaySMBUser.title: CreateGatewaySMBUser
CreateGatewaySMBUser.summary: Adds an SMB user to a file gateway.

DeleteExpressSync.title: DeleteExpressSync
DeleteExpressSync.summary: Deletes a specified express synchronization group.

DeleteGateway.summary: Deletes a pay-as-you-go gateway from its cluster.

DeleteGatewayBlockVolumes.summary: Deletes the specified iSCSI gateway block volumes.

DeleteGatewayCacheDisk.summary: Deletes a cache disk from a file gateway.

DeleteGatewayFileShares.title: DeleteGatewayFileShares
DeleteGatewayFileShares.summary: Deletes one or more file shares from a file gateway.

DeleteGatewayLogging.title: DeleteGatewayLogging
DeleteGatewayLogging.summary: Deletes the log monitoring feature for a gateway.

DeleteGatewaySMBUser.title: DeleteGatewaySMBUser
DeleteGatewaySMBUser.summary: Deletes a specified Server Message Block (SMB) user from a file gateway.

DeployGateway.title: DeployGateway
DeployGateway.summary: You can call the DeployGateway operation to deploy a pay-as-you-go gateway.

DescribeAccountConfig.title: DescribeAccountConfig
DescribeAccountConfig.summary: Retrieves the configuration of an account.

DescribeExpressSyncs.title: DescribeExpressSyncs
DescribeExpressSyncs.summary: Queries the details of express synchronization groups, including their names, IDs, and bucket names.

DescribeGateway.title: DescribeGateway
DescribeGateway.summary: Queries basic information about a gateway, such as its status and type, based on the specified gateway ID.

DescribeGatewayADInfo.title: DescribeGatewayADInfo
DescribeGatewayADInfo.summary: Queries information about the AD server configured for a gateway.

DescribeGatewayBlockVolumes.title: DescribeGatewayBlockVolumes
DescribeGatewayBlockVolumes.summary: Queries details about iSCSI gateway volumes, such as operation status, data transfer, address, capacity, port, CHAP, OSS Bucket SSL, LUN ID, and volume status.

DescribeGatewayCaches.title: DescribeGatewayCaches
DescribeGatewayCaches.summary: Queries information about cache disks, such as size and type.

DescribeGatewayDNS.title: DescribeGatewayDNS

DescribeGatewayFileShares.title: DescribeGatewayFileShares
DescribeGatewayFileShares.summary: Describes the configurations of file shares on a file gateway.

DescribeGatewayImages.title: DescribeGatewayImages
DescribeGatewayImages.summary: Queries details of on-premises gateway images, including their names and descriptions.

DescribeGatewayLocations.title: DescribeGatewayLocations

DescribeGatewayLogging.title: DescribeGatewayLogging
DescribeGatewayLogging.summary: Queries the logging configurations of a gateway, including the logging status, Simple Log Service (SLS) project name, and Logstore name.

DescribeGatewayModificationClasses.title: DescribeGatewayModificationClasses
DescribeGatewayModificationClasses.summary: Queries the instance types to which a gateway can be upgraded.

DescribeGatewayNFSClients.title: DescribeGatewayNFSClients
DescribeGatewayNFSClients.summary: Queries the NFS clients for a file gateway.

DescribeGatewaySMBClients.title: DescribeGatewaySMBClients
DescribeGatewaySMBClients.summary: Queries the Server Message Block (SMB) clients of a file gateway.

DescribeGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy.title: DescribeGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy
DescribeGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy.summary: Queries the Server Message Block (SMB) security level configuration of a gateway.

DescribeGatewaySMBUsers.title: DescribeGatewaySMBUsers
DescribeGatewaySMBUsers.summary: Queries the list of SMB usernames on a file gateway.

DescribeGatewayTypes.title: DescribeGatewayTypes

DescribeGateways.title: DescribeGateways
DescribeGateways.summary: Queries a list of gateways and returns their IDs and names.

DescribeRegions.title: DescribeRegions

DescribeStorageBundle.title: DescribeStorageBundle
DescribeStorageBundle.summary: Queries information about a gateway cluster, including its region, timestamp, name, and description.

DescribeStorageBundles.title: DescribeStorageBundles

DescribeTasks.title: DescribeTasks

DisableGatewayLogging.title: DisableGatewayLogging

EnableGatewayLogging.title: EnableGatewayLogging
EnableGatewayLogging.summary: Enables log monitoring for a gateway.

ExpandCacheDisk.title: ExpandCacheDisk

ExpandGatewayFileShare.title: ExpandGatewayFileShare
ExpandGatewayFileShare.summary: Increases the capacity of a share for an on-premises gateway.

ExpandGatewayNetworkBandwidth.title: ExpandGatewayNetworkBandwidth
ExpandGatewayNetworkBandwidth.summary: Expands the public bandwidth of a gateway.

ListAlertEvents.title: ListAlertEvents
ListAlertEvents.summary: Lists alert events for a gateway.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Lists the tags attached to one or more gateways.

ModifyGateway.title: ModifyGateway
ModifyGateway.summary: Modifies a specified gateway's basic information, including its name and description.

ModifyGatewayClass.title: ModifyGatewayClass
ModifyGatewayClass.summary: Upgrades the gateway class of an online gateway.

ModifyGatewayFileShareWatermark.title: ModifyGatewayFileShareWatermark
ModifyGatewayFileShareWatermark.summary: Modifies the watermark for a gateway file share.

ModifyStorageBundle.title: ModifyStorageBundle
ModifyStorageBundle.summary: Modifies the basic information of a specified gateway cluster, such as its name and description.

RemoveSharesFromExpressSync.title: RemoveSharesFromExpressSync

RestartFileShares.title: RestartFileShares

SetGatewayADInfo.title: SetGatewayADInfo
SetGatewayADInfo.summary: Sets or purges the AD server information for a gateway.

SetGatewayDNS.title: SetGatewayDNS
SetGatewayDNS.summary: Adds DNS server information to a file gateway.

SetGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy.title: SetGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy
SetGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy.summary: Sets the Server Message Block (SMB) security level for a gateway.

TagResources.title: TagResources

TriggerGatewayRemoteSync.title: TriggerGatewayRemoteSync

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Detaches tags from a specified gateway.

UpdateGatewayBlockVolume.title: UpdateGatewayBlockVolume
UpdateGatewayBlockVolume.summary: Updates the configuration of a block volume on an iSCSI gateway.

UpdateGatewayFileShare.title: UpdateGatewayFileShare
UpdateGatewayFileShare.summary: This operation updates the configuration of a file share for a file gateway.
